 ## Custody lease extension (2026-10-18, Git phase 04)
 
-[Git §6](../../git/spec.md#6-n7-and-rul84) owns the custody contract. Execution holds one existing dispatch-cwd lease across the whole writing Unit, including provider-limit failover, runner commits, persisted receipts and handoff. Direct and terminal Assignments receive the same acquired handle; their supervisor declares its domain on the lease on every platform. Commit and sync children borrow the handle; only the attempt copy closes at binding. A completed holder clears its own unchanged predecessor under exclusion after observing the domain empty. Throw paths preserve that record. A failed handoff preserves the settled outcome and returns `custody-handoff-not-recorded`; admission of a new writing Unit happens before its run is created or announced.
+[Git §6](../../git/spec.md#6-n7-and-rul84-one-write-scope-matcher) owns the custody contract. Execution holds one existing dispatch-cwd lease across the whole writing Unit, including provider-limit failover, runner commits, persisted receipts and handoff. Direct and terminal Assignments receive the same acquired handle; their supervisor declares its domain on the lease on every platform. Commit and sync children borrow the handle; only the attempt copy closes at binding. A completed holder clears its own unchanged predecessor under exclusion after observing the domain empty. Throw paths preserve that record. A failed handoff preserves the settled outcome and returns `custody-handoff-not-recorded`; admission of a new writing Unit happens before its run is created or announced.
 
 Successor admission refuses best-effort or unprovable predecessor domains with `custody-predecessor-unknown` and recovery details naming `git-worktree-recovery`/preserve/new-worktree. Writing inline and unsupervised producers refuse with `custody-domain-required`; `--force-shared-cwd` with mutation refuses with `custody-required`. Read-only sharing remains supported. Workflow catches this admission refusal and creates a fresh worktree through its existing creation door, starting from the recorded base commit; it journals the preserved checkout/branch and uses the replacement branch for integration. Explicit `fgos run --worktree` still stops with the cause. The `git-worktree-recovery` doctor check belongs to Git phase 03; this phase retains recovery metadata only. Read-only executor calls do not capture commit evidence or monitor writes; supervised Assignment settlement owns stray-write and lost-uncommitted-path diagnostics. This is intentional: generic read-only execution supplies no mutation certification, while supervised read-only Assignments retain mutation detection. Evidence and exact reproduction commands: [phase report](../../../../plans/reports/phase-lead-261018-2305-git-p04-custody-lease.md). No new record type or lock row. Caller audit, fixture migration and Workflow recovery evidence: [unit 2 report](../../../../plans/reports/phase-lead-261019-0039-git-p04-u2-redispatch-and-migration.md).
